chunks.sanskrit: ayaṃ duḥkhavrātavrataparigame pāraṇavidhir mahāsaukhyāsāraprasaraṇarase durdinam idam | yad anyanyakkṛtyā viṣamaviśikhaploṣaṇaguror vibhoḥ stotre śaśvat pratiphalati ceto gatabhayam
chunks.l1:
## kram-p01 (1)
This hymn is the course of great ease; in the midst of the host of sorrows, the rite of completion, the essence of great bliss flowing, this inauspicious day — constantly, on the worshipper's conduct, reflecting, it reflects back; the mind, fear-gone, in the hymn. // AgKs_1
chunks.l2:
## kram-p01–p05 — the hymn's purpose and the self's nature
This hymn is the course of great ease: in the midst of the host of sorrows, the rite of completion, the essence of great bliss flowing, this inauspicious day. Constantly, on the worshipper's conduct, reflecting, it reflects back; the mind, fear-gone, in the hymn. Examining own self, examining again the hymned conduct, the worshipper in hymn-practice without effort; the examined self, in all-knowable-moment, that thus in hymn I, here, always, without effort. Ungrasped, own self is never knower of thing-knowledge; ungrasped, own self indeed is not. Śiva is that self, shining, all-thing-one-sap; hence I in hymn with devoted heart always blissful. By varied birth-etc.-wandering-course-garments, omniscience gained in heart; that inside, teaching-spread-course-become light, clearly in speech obtained, now I hymn without effort. Shaking off bond-abiding-conceit, enjoying varied things, by great fire of hymn-hutāśana, burned difference; varied self-splendor-rush, drinking things, varada, maddened, blissful. The hymn's purpose: by self-examination and hymn-practice, fear is removed, omniscience gained, difference burned, and bliss arises.

chunks.sanskrit: anāmṛṣṭaḥ svātmā na hi bhavati bhāvapramitibhāj anāmṛṣṭaḥ svātmety api hi na vinā 'marśanavidheḥ | śivaś cāsau svātmā sphurad akhilabhāvaikasarasas tato 'ham tvatstotre pravaṇahṛdayo nityasukhitaḥ
vicitrair jātyādibhramaṇaparipāṭīparikarair avāptam sārvajñaṃ hṛdaya yad ayatnena bhavatā | tad antas tvadbodhaprasarasaraṇībhūtamahasi sphuṭam vāci prāpya prakaṭaya vibhoḥ stotram adhunā

chunks.sanskrit: bhava prājyaiśvaryaprathitabahuśakter bhagavato vicitraṃ cāritraṃ hṛdayam adhiśete yadi tataḥ | kathaṃ stotraṃ kuryād atha ca kurute tena sahasā śivaikātmyaprāptau śivanatir upāyaḥ prathamakaḥ
jvaladrūpaṃ bhāsvatpacanam atha dāhaṃ prakaṭanam vimucyānyad vahneḥ kim api ghaṭate naiva hi vapuḥ | stuve saṃvidraśmīn yadi nijanijāṃs tena sa nuto bhaven nānyaḥ kaścid bhavati parameśasya vibhavaḥ
vicitrārambhatve galitaniyame yaḥ kila rasaḥ paricchedābhāvāt paramaparipūrṇatvam asamam | svayaṃ bhāsāṃ yogaḥ sakalabhavabhāvaikamayatāviruddhair dharmaughaiḥ paracitir anarghocitaguṇā
itīdṛkṣair rūpair varada vividhaṃ te kila vapur vibhāti svāṃśe 'smin jagati gatabhedaṃ bhagavataḥ | tad evaitatstotuṃ hṛdayam atha gīrbāhyakaraṇaprabandhāś ca syur me satatam aparityaktarabhasaḥ
tavaivaikasyāntaḥ sphuritamahaso bodhajaladher vicitrormivrātaprasaraṇaraso yaḥ svarasataḥ | ta evāmī sṛṣṭisthitilayamayasphūrjitarucāṃ śaśāṅkārkāgnīnāṃ yugapad udayāpāyavibhavāḥ
chunks.l1:
## kram-p09 (9)
By such forms, varada, varied your body shines; in own-portion this world, difference-gone, Lord's. That same this hymn-to, heart and speech-outer-instrument-bonds would be mine, constant, unabandoned-rush. // AgKs_9

chunks.sanskrit: ataś citrācitrakramataditarādisthitijuṣo vibhoḥ śaktiḥ śaśvad vrajati na vibhedaṃ katham api | tad etasyāṃ bhūmāv akulam iti te yat kila padaṃ tadekāgrībhūyān mama hṛdayabhūr bhairava vibho
amuṣmāt saṃpūrnāt vata rasamahollāsasarasān nijāṃ śaktiṃ bhedaṃ gamayasi nijecchāprasarataḥ | anarghaṃ svātantryaṃ tava tadidam atyadbhutamayīṃ bhavacchaktiṃ stunvan vigalitabhayo 'haṃ śivamayaḥ
chunks.l1:
## kram-p11 (11)
Hence varied-varied-course-station-other-distinction-etc.-standing-thing-enjoying-power, Lord's power, always goes, no difference how. That in this ground (akula), Bhairava, your pada — that one-pointed become my heart-ground, Bhairava Lord. // AgKs_11
chunks.l2:
## kram-p11–p15 — the ground, the course, and the body
Hence varied-varied-course-station-other-distinction-etc.-standing-thing-enjoying-power, Lord's power, always goes, no difference how. That in this ground (akula), Bhairava, your pada — that one-pointed become my heart-ground, Bhairava Lord. In measure, dissolved, Śiva-pada-shining-power-vaibhava-force, body-breath-and-rest limited-made-agentness-standing; when time-condition, dissolution-state approaches you — then goddess, which, shining, my, she be Śiva-made. Course-rush of it, in earth, making difference-grasping, own-powers, Lord, teach always in own-self; then three-formed (knowledge/action/will) standing-maintenance-dissolution-great-creation-power, become-immersed wishful heart. Formerly creation dissolved, fire-formed, which there would shine, beyond-rush-facing, moon-touch-lovely; fire-moon-splendor-both-glory, Bhairava Lord, this creation-named, my mind, always shining.

chunks.sanskrit: idantāvad rūpaṃ tava bhagavataḥ śaktisarasaṃ kramābhāvād eva prasabhavigalat kālakalanam | manaḥśaktyā vācāpy atha karaṇacakrair bahir atho ghaṭādyais tadrūpaṃ yugapad adhitiṣṭheyam aniśam
kramollāsaṃ tasyāṃ bhuvi viracayan bhedakalanāṃ svaśaktīnāṃ deva prathayasi sadā svātmani tataḥ | kriyājñānecchākhyāṃ sthitilayamahāsṛṣṭivibhavāṃ trirūpaṃ bhūyāsaṃ samadhiśayituṃ vyagrahṛdayaḥ

chunks.l1:
## kram-p14 (14)
Formerly creation dissolved, fire-formed, which there would shine, beyond-rush-facing, moon-touch-lovely; fire-moon-splendor-both-glory, Bhairava Lord, this creation-named, my mind, always shining. // AgKs_14

chunks.sanskrit: visṛṣṭe bhāvāṃśe bahir atiśayāsvādavirase yadā tatraiva tvaṃ bhajasi rabhasād raktimayatām | tadā raktā devī tava sakalabhāveṣu nanu māṃ kriyād raktāpānakramaghaṭitagoṣṭhīgataghṛṇam
bahir vṛttiṃ hātuṃ citibhuvam udārāṃ nivasituṃ yadā bhāvābhedaṃ prathayasi vinaṣṭormicapalaḥ | sthiter nāśaṃ devī kalayati tadā sā tava vibho sthiteḥ sāṃsārikyāḥ kalayatu vināśaṃ mama sadā
chunks.l1:
## kram-p16 (16)
Outside-conduct abandoning, consciousness-ground dwelling, to dwell, when things-difference showing, waveless, stability-lost; of maintenance dissolution, goddess, your, maintenance-of-saṃsāra, my, always dissolve. // AgKs_16
chunks.l2:
## kram-p16–p20 — dissolution and the three powers
Released, things-portion, outside extreme tasteless, when there you, by rush, raktimayatā; then red goddess, your all-things, indeed me, by action-raktāpāna-course-made gathering, make red. Outside-conduct abandoning, consciousness-ground dwelling, to dwell, when things-difference showing, waveless, stability-lost; of maintenance dissolution, goddess, your, maintenance-of-saṃsāra, my, always dissolve. World-dissolution wishing, by own-rush, own-doubt-fear-named procedure then prohibition teaching; Yama created thus, then again doubt dissolving, great-goddess, that my world-fear she dissolve. Dissolved doubt-mass, instantly, full, Lord, power, all-knowable-host swallowing, by enjoyment-rush, Bhairava, dissolution-named, my heart, difference-portion, strike. Thus by goddesses, instantly, difference-power melted, thought-life-breath, shining, mother-standing, enough; hence dissolution-portion, own-heart reflected, standing, blissful, she be, goddess, my, death-dissolution-maker.

chunks.sanskrit: vilīne śaṅkaughe sapadi paripūrṇe ca vibhave gate lokācāre galitavibhave śāstraniyame | anantaṃ bhogyaughaṃ grasitum abhito laṃpaṭarasā vibho saṃhārākhyā mama hṛdi bhidāṃśaṃ praharatu

## kram-p23 (23)
Whole, unmeasured, in self, again-and-again, mass-full-mahāraśmi-nivaha; to make parā divine-bliss, by generous, rest, heart-place beautify. // AgKs_23

## kram-p25 (25)

## kram-p28 (28)
Thus own-power-ray-mass-succession, having heard, Lord, if you go to grace; by that quickly, all-folk, own-doctrine-ray, all-darkness-mass removed, make. // AgKs_28
